card.name: Digits inside numbers in tables
card.fires_on: A single digit or decimal point in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as a percentage, a patient count fraction or a tablet strength. It appears in clinical tables and dose charts, and the number is not yet finished.

modes.label: Counts and percentages
modes.description: A digit inside a patient count or percentage in trial results.

modes.label: Dose table numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a dose in mg or a series of table values.

card.plain: It fires on a digit partway through a number in a results or dosing table, before the number is complete.
